Name: Truffle Guard
Author: jaericknexus
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size][color=#D4D4D8]
Avoid accidental pig petting! Disables animal interactions within range of a nearby pickable truffle.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size][color=#D4D4D8]
Unzip to Stardew's Mods folder[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Makes animals within range of a pickable truffle un-interactable[/*]
[*]Extended custom range for large pig pens[/*]
[*]Toggle to view affected range as translucent overlay [/*]
[*]Optional toggle to allow animal interactions with shears or milk pail equipped[/*]
[/list][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52019/52019-1788971398-1531142778.png[/img]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Optional in-game menu compatibility with GMCM[/color]

Manifest.Name: Truffle Guard
Manifest.Description: Stops nearby animals from stealing your input (petting / info popup) while you're picking truffles off the ground.
Manifest.Author: littleguygreens
